Subject: Post-demo: security discovery, IR timelines, and BAA next steps for Quantum Health

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for your time today and for walking us through Quantum Health's primary use cases. As promised, I wanted to capture the security and compliance items we discussed and outline immediate next steps so your procurement and security teams have what they need.

Quick recap of asks from your side:
- SOC 2 status and expected evidence we can share with your security team
- Confirmation on HIPAA/BAA requirements and any specific phrasing you need
- Timeline expectations for incident notification and BCP/DR evidence
- Completed vendor security questionnaire or the form you prefer we fill

From our side, next steps I can action this week:
1) Share current SOC 2 status export + our IR playbook and BCP runbook samples.
2) Kick off the vendor security questionnaire fill (attach our point person for gaps).
3) Send a BAA redline template to expedite legal review if Quantum requires one.

Can you confirm the security contact we should work with? I saw Evan on the call — is he the right primary or should procurement be the thread owner (procureops@quantumhealth.com)? Also, do you have a target date for procurement/security sign-off?

I attached a short checklist of deliverables and will loop in our security lead pending your confirmation of the correct contact.

Thanks — speak soon.

— Olga

Subject: Re: Post-demo: security discovery, IR timelines, and BAA next steps for Quantum Health

Hi Olga —

Appreciate the clear recap. Evan is the right security contact for technical evidence; procurement (procureops) will own contract/BAA. A couple of clarifications so we can triage internally:

- SOC 2: we need a high-level status (type I vs II, controls covered, most recent test date) and the set of artifacts you can share (we generally accept SOC 2+bridge letters or exported control evidence).
- HIPAA / BAA: Quantum requires a BAA before any PHI processing. We can review a redline version but aim to accelerate — procurement would like a proposed BAA within 3 business days.
- Incident response & breach notification: we require vendor notification to be no later than 72 hours after discovery for incidents impacting PHI, and we will request a post-incident report within 14 days.
- Vendor questionnaire: we attach our standard information security questionnaire (I will resend if you don't have it).

Can you confirm if Redwood already has a standard BAA template and if you can produce an IR timeline example and BCP evidence (runbook excerpts, DR test dates)?

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan | Head of Security & Privacy
Quantum Health

Team — forwarding Samira's note. Quantum Health is a high-priority deal (QH-4321). Procurement wants a BAA within 3 business days and security needs artifacts for SOC2 status + IR/BCP evidence. Key asks:
- SOC 2 status summary + shareable artifacts (what can we safely provide)
- IR breach notification policy confirming 72-hour discovery-to-notify SLA and sample post-incident report
- BCP/DR test evidence (last tabletop/exercise dates, RTO/RPO statements)

Olga
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 12:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo: security discovery, IR timelines, and BAA next steps for Quantum Health

Olga / all —

Quick status from Security & Compliance (what we can provide this week):

- SOC 2: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type I (controls design) and is in-progress for Type II (operational effectiveness). Expected Type II audit completion: 2026-04-15. Immediate deliverable: a SOC 2 status export (.csv) summarizing control families, last test dates, and compensating controls — attached as SOC2-Status-Export.csv.

- IR / breach notification: Our published policy requires vendor notification within 72 hours of confirmed discovery for incidents involving customer data. We can share:
  * IR_Playbook_v0.2.pdf (redacted for internal investigator identities) — includes triage steps, escalation matrix, and sample timeline templates.
  * Sample post-incident report template and a recent anonymized post-mortem (redacted).

- BCP / DR evidence: We maintain a DR runbook and yearly tabletop exercise records. Deliverables this week: runbook excerpts and last tabletop summary (date: 2025-11-06). RTO/RPO targets by service are included in the runbook excerpts.

- Vendor security questionnaire: we can assign a reviewer to fill the Quantum form, but for completeness we prefer they accept our questionnaire export or allow us to submit a completed vendor questionnaire back. Attached is a preliminary filled questionnaire template: Vendor-Security-Questionnaire_QH.docx.

- BAA: Legal has a redlineable BAA template (BAA_Redline_Template.docx). Marcus is looping legal for an internal review; we should be able to share a proposed redline within 48 hours.

Proposed next steps:
1) Olga: send the attached files to Quantum with a short covering note and propose a call between Evan and our security lead to walk artifacts (can be scheduled this week).
2) Marcus/legal: finalize BAA redline and post to DocuSign link for Quantum procurement.
3) Rishi: prepare control mapping doc for the SOC 2 export and note any temporary compensating controls.

I attached the files we can share immediately. If Quantum needs unredacted evidence (e.g., audit logs), that requires an executed NDA/BAA — we'll flag that in the covering note.

-Neha
